program_solutions:
(rule!
  ;; Laser from a 2-cell green(3) seed: beams start at every seed cell along
  ;; the seed's axis (one shared row -> horizontal, else vertical), paint
  ;; traversed orange(7) green, SPLIT perpendicular at cyan(8) walls, and stop
  ;; at grid edges. Pure worklist over (r c dr dc) beam states.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (open? (lambda (r c) (and (in-bounds? r c h w) (!= (at g r c) 8))))
           (seeds (find-color g 3))
           (horiz (= 1 (length (unique (map first seeds)))))
           (dirs (if horiz
                     (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))
                     (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))))
           (start (flatmap (lambda (p)
                             (map (lambda (d)
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (first d) (second d)))
                                  dirs))
                           seeds))
           (filled
             (let run ((stack start) (visited (list)) (acc seeds))
               (cond
                 ((null? stack) acc)
                 ((member (first stack) visited)
                  (run (rest stack) visited acc))
                 (else
                  (let* ((head (first stack))
                         (dr (third head))
                         (dc (fourth head))
                         (seen (cons head visited)))
                    (let march ((cr (first head)) (cc (second head)) (hit acc))
                      (let ((nr (+ cr dr)) (nc (+ cc dc)))
                        (cond
                          ((open? nr nc) (march nr nc (cons (list nr nc) hit)))
                          ((and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 8))
                           (let* ((perp (if (!= dc 0)
                                            (list (list 1 0) (list -1 0))
                                            (list (list 0 1) (list 0 -1))))
                                  (splits (map (lambda (d)
                                                 (list cr cc (first d) (second d)))
                                               (filter (lambda (d)
                                                         (open? (+ cr (first d))
                                                                (+ cc (second d))))
                                                       perp))))
                             (run (append splits (rest stack)) seen hit)))
                          (else (run (rest stack) seen hit)))))))))))
      (cellmap g (r c v)
        (if (and (= v 7) (member (list r c) filled)) 3 v)))))
